method: Primary product and support pages; only positively documented capabilities are marked as observed. Unlisted capabilities are unknown, not absent.

competitors.name: Roadtrippers
competitors.notes: Official membership page documents Autopilot, RV-oriented tools, map overlays and exports. Pricing and plan gates can change; recheck before commercial decisions.

competitors.name: AdventureGenie
competitors.notes: Official feature page describes profile-powered recommendations, AI assistant and RV trip planning.

competitors.name: RV LIFE Trip Wizard
competitors.notes: Official product page documents height/weight-aware routes, cost estimates and campgrounds.

competitors.name: Wanderlog
competitors.notes: Official product page lists these capabilities; some may require a paid plan.

competitors.name: TripIt
competitors.notes: Official comparison distinguishes free itinerary organization from Pro alerts.

competitors.name: AllTrails
competitors.notes: Official page describes offline trail maps as a paid feature.

competitors.name: iOverlander
competitors.notes: Official pages describe the current app and optional subscriptions; do not infer route-planner parity.

competitors.name: Navionics Boating
competitors.notes: Garmin states Auto Guidance+ is for planning, not safe navigation replacement.

opportunities.userProblem: Travel partners coordinate plans across devices
opportunities.proposal: Evaluate invited collaborators with explicit permissions after the solo canonical-state model is proven.

opportunities.userProblem: Travel details become fragmented across email and booking sites
opportunities.proposal: Evaluate user-controlled reservation imports first; assess alert providers and data rights separately.

opportunities.capability: Offline marine charts and waypoint transfer
opportunities.userProblem: Boaters need dependable plans when connectivity fails
opportunities.proposal: Assess licensed chart integration; retain Groundbnb's authored GPS/road-access separation and clear safety limits.

opportunities.userProblem: RV travelers must avoid unsuitable roads and budget fuel/stays
opportunities.proposal: Compare the already specified RV constraints and totals against real user journeys before adding new scope.
